newsitem.title: INDIA: India's DSP Merrill launches bond, equity funds.
newsitem.headline: India's DSP Merrill launches bond, equity funds.

text.p: DSP Merrill Lynch Asset Management (India) Ltd on Tuesday launched two open-ended mutual funds in the company's maiden efforts for the Indian market.
The DSP Merrill Lynch Bond Fund and the DSP Merrill Lynch Equity Fund will be open for subscription from April 7 through April 15.
The bond fund plans to invest 75 percent of its portfolio in debt securities, 15 percent in money market securities and the remaining 10 percent in equity-linked securities.
It targets a minimum subscription of 150 million rupees.

The equity fund -- which aims to raise a minimum of 50 million rupees during the initial offer period -- will invest 90 percent of its portfolio in equity-related securities and 10 percent in debt securities.
Hemendra Kothari, chairman of DSP Merrill Lynch Asset Management said though the bond fund would not have any entry or exit load, the equity fund would have an entry load of three percent.
DSP Merrill Lynch Asset Management is a venture of investment bank DSP Merrill Lynch and Merrill Lynch Asset Management. DSP Merrill Lynch is the Indian affiliate of the U.S. investment bank.
